metadata.what: Peak memory of each STT pod while bench_turn (or, for moonshine and parakeet, tools/stt_mem.py-style repeated requests) ran its requests against it
metadata.how: kubectl top pod (metrics-server working set) sampled every 10-20 s during the run; VRAM is nvidia-smi memory.used on the GTX 1650 sampled alongside, idle baseline 14-29 MiB included
metadata.note: Sampled peaks, so a short spike between samples can be missed. Working set is not the same measure as the TTS chart's process RSS; compare within this file.
